question: For each enrollment, show the client id, the program code and the name of the program.
reply:
```sql
SELECT "people"."enrollment"."client_id", "org"."program"."program_code", "org"."program"."name"
FROM "people"."enrollment"
JOIN "org"."program" ON "people"."enrollment"."program_code" = "org"."program"."program_code" 
AND "people"."enrollment"."agency_id" = "org"."program"."agency_id";
```
